title: Revert to version 14

requirements.text: Revert the Dashboard navigation from the dropdown menu (introduced in version 15) back to the flat navigation button row that existed in version 14.
acceptanceCriteria: The Dashboard no longer uses a shadcn DropdownMenu for navigation.
All navigation sections (Summary, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time, Verification) are rendered as individual flat buttons in a row, matching the version 14 layout.
Navigation between tabs functions correctly after the revert.

constraints: Do not change any backend logic or data models.
Do not modify any files listed under frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Introducing any new features or UI changes beyond reverting the navigation to version 14.
Modifying backend/main.mo or any Motoko files.
